rules.statement: Write code comments in the timeless present and leave out change-relative words such as "now", "no longer" or "used to" that describe behavior compared with an earlier version.
rules.why: A comment with change-relative wording reads wrongly to someone who never saw the earlier behavior.
rules.check: Look in added or edited `//` and `///` comments for words like "now", "no longer", "used to", "previously" or "new" that compare the code with an earlier version instead of describing what it does.
